scripts.stage:core: bun run apps/shell/scripts/build-core.ts && bun run apps/shell/scripts/stage-sidecar.ts
scripts.build:shell: bun run stage:core && bun apps/shell/scripts/tauri.ts build --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.build:shell:nightly: bun run stage:core && bun apps/shell/scripts/tauri.ts build --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.nightly.conf.json
scripts.build:shell:dev: bun run stage:core && bun apps/shell/scripts/tauri.ts build --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.check: bun run check:copy && bun run check:architecture && bun run --cwd packages/contracts check && bun run --cwd packages/core check && bun run --cwd packages/ui check && bun run --cwd packages/plugin-sdk check && bun run --cwd examples/plugins/hello check && bun run check:e2e && bun run check:bench && bun run check:android-server && bun run check:stress && bun run check:telemetry
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/ui test
scripts.e2e: bun run build:ui && bun test tests/e2e
